title: [DOC-3] Universal IdP profile uses one key for both VC issuance and DID-log updates
description: Review finding DOC-3: Universal IdP profile uses one key for both VC issuance and DID-log updates (lens DOC). Location: profiles/universal-idp-did.md:49-53, :644-655; contrast profiles/gsuite-employer-did.md:150, :456-458. Fix: As proposed. universal:53 says `signing_key_path = ... # also signs DID log entries (§9)`, and :644 offers one backend config "for both keys". gsuite:150 says the issuer key "is separate from the update key of the employee logs ... so it confers no authority over any employee's DID log". Add separate `update_key_*` and `provisioning_signing_key_*` entries that mirror gsuite:456-458, and remove the comment. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
